releases.name: Field feedback loop
releases.targetWindow: Client complete; live measurement pending an author-operated endpoint + userbase
releases.summary: Opt-in, off-by-default feedback loop that turns the userbase into the fleet: users label findings true/false-positive and anonymous heuristic fingerprints are pushed to a write-only sink, so the real-world false-positive rate can be measured. Egress-only by design.

releases.name: Initial Architext build-out
releases.summary: Architecture and release data replaced with source-backed project facts; the CLI shipped ABORT-gated.

releases.name: Interactive TUI triage face
releases.targetWindow: Personal/beta now; public publish gated on field false-positive measurement
releases.summary: Add an interactive tcell TUI over the existing three-phase pipeline: live scan or read-only --from snapshot, master-detail triage, consented quarantine and restore through the same hardened act path. ABORT-gated at rc3.

releases.name: Liveness scoring + backlog hardening
releases.summary: Current develop cycle: tech-debt hardening already merged (atomic feedback-store writes; Clean egress identity strings at the source), plus the planned liveness dimension (active/armed/dormant, fed into scoring so a dead persistence remnant scores below a live one) and Findings concern-coloring + revisitable decision flags. Real destination names (SNI/DNS) tracked as the next feature.

releases.name: Egress monitor
releases.targetWindow: v0.4.0-rc1 on the feat/egress-monitor branch; real destination names deferred to v0.4.1 (packet capture)
releases.summary: Live 'egress top': per-application outbound traffic (rate, destinations, cadence) through the trust/provenance lens, with an inferred exfiltration risk (capability x egress). Sudo-CLI observation (nettop + lsof), observe-only, reads no payloads.

releases.name: Inspection interceptor & egress zoom
releases.summary: Turns the egress monitor from 'what/where/how much' into 'let me look': native /dev/bpf per-flow inspection with an honest coverage verdict (plaintext vs encrypted-metadata-only), a btm-style per-app zoom dashboard with a braille line graph (by PID or by destination), a port-heuristic encryption glyph across the views, and a live-speed fix (nettop -n) that took sampling from ~5s to ~10ms.

releases.name: Codesign-in-release fix + comprehensive CI
releases.summary: Patch release. Fixes a shipped-binary bug — goreleaser built with CGO_ENABLED=0, which silently dropped the cgo code-signature collector, so released binaries did no codesign checks (v0.5.0 was affected). Rebuilds with cgo + a compile-time guard, and restructures the Actions pipeline so a release passes the exact same comprehensive gate as CI.

releases.name: Honest inspection + Exfiltration polish
releases.summary: Patch release from live use. Inspection no longer overstates or hides: 'ENCRYPTED (TLS)' requires real evidence (SNI/handshake/TLS-port), and captured wire bytes are always shown — readable text as text, cleartext-binary as a hexdump — instead of a false 'metadata only'. Plus the Exfiltration tree now scrolls, the views say 'Exfiltration' (not 'Egress'), and the README is reorganized with real screenshots.
